text:
• Flash cards now use spaced repetition: the app shows which words are due for review
• Go through all your words or only your favorites in one tap
• New Progress page: sessions, answers, accuracy and how many words you have mastered
• Dark mode: system, light or dark theme
• Daily practice reminder to keep your learning streak going
• Backup: export and import your database, share word lists or restore an automatic backup
• Your exercise session survives an app restart
• Better translations and a faster start-up
• Minor improvements and bug fixes
